item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00287","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C12","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C15 supplies a highly specific drafting template: both orders open designated federal tax returns to inspection by a named government body and make that inspection subject to a Treasury decision approved by the President on the same day. The child adapts this machinery by changing the covered tax returns, years, and inspecting agency, while adding the agency's statutory purpose and an effective-date sentence. C12 and C08 share only weaker amendment/effective-date features and do not approach this distinctive mechanism.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"corporation income tax returns ... shall be open to inspection by the Federal Trade Commission","parent_excerpt":"income, excess-profits, and declared value excess-profits tax returns ... shall be open for inspection by the Military Renegotiation Policy and Review Board","explanation":"Both use the same operative device of opening specified classes and years of tax returns to inspection by a designated federal body."},{"child_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of returns by the Federal Trade Commission, approved by me this date","parent_excerpt":"subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of returns by such Board, approved by me this day","explanation":"This is distinctive parallel administrative machinery tying inspection to a same-day, presidentially approved Treasury decision."}]}
